title: A quarter of orders, set next to several hundred from outside agents
intro: Switch between DoorDash’s third-quarter total and what Tony Xu said about orders from outside AI agents. The page does not divide one by the other.
note: 993 million is every completed order in the third quarter of 2026. The 28% is the year-over-year change in that total. The 17% is the same change with the Deliveroo acquisition left out. Both are from DoorDash’s 30 October earnings release. “Several hundred” is Tony Xu’s description, on the 29 October call, of third-party agent orders across the whole time those agents have been running. He also said “maybe several hundred.” It is not a precise count, not a quarterly figure, and not DoorDash’s own Ask, text or connector tools. The two sides are not a rate.
